# netcup_clouddns_acme_challenges (Data Source)

The ACME challenges of a domain on CloudDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_acme_challenges" "all" {
  domain_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `challenges` (Attributes List) ACME challenges of the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--challenges))

<a id="nestedatt--challenges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `challenges`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) Name of the challenge record.
- `scope` (String) `@` for the zone apex or a hostname label.
- `status` (String) Status of the challenge.
- `value` (String) Challenge value.
